style.name: B1 Cook’s Pen
style.description: Observational black ink contours and loose hatching, playful restrained olive/ochre/rust wash, warm paper supplied by chapter background. True alpha around object drawings; no circular backing or frame. Clear outer contour and physical contents take priority over tiny ornamental detail.
style.viewpoint: Consistent gentle oblique view; tilt bowls enough to show contents and use honest cut sections where fillings matter.

hotspots.visibleDistinguishingCues: Open rectangular pass and clear ledge; notebook finale is preparing a complete serving, no train setting required.

occurrences.placementStatus: Proposed centre; verify actual panel geometry and arrival clutter before adopting.
occurrences.backgroundTreatment: Warm cream notebook page with faint upper gestures and a stronger low botanical sketch outside the receiving area; no enclosing border.

hotspots.integration: Place as a fixed apparatus drawing naturally printed on the cookbook page. Reuse the same art for repeated physical apparatus while preserving every semantic hotspot ID. Review each occurrence in its own panel.

compound.renderOrder: Base then overlays in declared slot order.
compound.plan: Generate the empty nearly frontal trolley separately from ordinary atlases, drawing its three shelves around the reserved fitting rectangles; shelf surfaces approximately y=65,116,164 in display pixels. Reuse the standalone food drawings as scaled fitted layers; retain full base-size transparent padding. Do not regenerate a whole loaded trolley for each slot.

slots.note: Top shelf left: miniature complete meal, bean bowl and bread remain two visible forms.
Top shelf right: tall jug, preserve clear handle and amber liquid.
Middle shelf right: small sealed ribbed tin, no opening.
Middle shelf left: pale cake and white filling, separate from tin and dark cake.
Bottom shelf centre: dark cake with white icing cap, may coexist with vanilla cake.

compound.validation: Inspect all 32 masks at 190×180 display pixels, including both cakes together. No fitting may cover wheels, handles, other food or the shelf immediately below it. Fitted miniatures are an explicit assembly-scale exception to the standalone 60px floor.
